_comment: A broken cavalry squadron outruns a pursuing squadron of its own type in the close sim tier. Team 1's 16 horses spawn ALREADY routing (starting_state 3, morale pinned low so the flight does not end in an early rally) facing south, their own back edge; team 0's 20 horses start 550 wu behind them and are sent down the same line at a sprint (four quick right-clicks on one point well past the router). The router builds up to its flee pace (1.3 x its sprint) at its own acceleration and then pulls away, its riders running with the block rather than strung out behind it; the pursuer, capped at its sprint, falls further behind every second. Before the fix the router's bodies got no feed-forward of the flight and the body coupling held the anchor to about a fifth of its flee pace (0.81 wu/tick against 3.683 on this staging), so the pursuer closed to within about 80 wu before the router rallied in its face. Its rout timer runs out clear of the pursuer at tick 355 and it rallies on the spot; the clip ends at tick 352, just before that, so it shows only the full-pace pull-away. Flat declared map (terrain empty) so pathing does not shape the run; drill mode (no other army). Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
